items.problem: Bootstrap silently omitted UWP project inputs linked from outside the source directory, leading to an incomplete mapping, manual shell reconstruction, compiler errors, and a missing package asset.
items.evidence: MIDI.csproj lines 96-179 link App/MainPage/styles/assets through Include+Link; bootstrap reported only 9 copied files; session-log.txt turns 5-23 rebuilt shared shell content manually; turn 33 failed because Splash-sdk.png was absent.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 and SKILL.md for linked, external, SharedContent, MSBuildThisFileDirectory, GetDirectoryNameOfFileAbove, and Link; no handling existed.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration recursively copied only the physical Source directory and treated that list as the authoritative project inventory.
items.proposed_fix: Extend Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to resolve UWP csproj properties used by common linked items, copy linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content files to their Link destinations, include them in mapping/triage, and fail rather than silently omit unresolved links.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP applications and Microsoft SDK samples frequently centralize shell code, resource dictionaries, and package assets in shared directories linked into multiple projects.

items.problem: The skill prescribed winapp build even though the CLI has no build command, and its dotnet fallback did not require an explicit csproj/platform.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 24: 'build' was not matched; turn 25: MSB1003 from dotnet build in the parent directory; turn 33: Test-AppLaunch could not find output under bin\x64\Debug after a platform-unspecified build.
items.skill_search: SKILL.md lines 126, 138, and 170 explicitly prescribed winapp build; lines 139-140 treated dotnet build as a fallback.
items.root_cause: The command contract was outdated and did not match either the installed CLI or the launch helper's platform-specific output discovery.
items.proposed_fix: Use native dotnet build with the explicit csproj, Debug configuration, and host platform throughout Step 3 and final validation guidance.
items.generalizes: Every migration uses the same build loop, and commands run from a benchmark parent directory cannot safely rely on current-directory project discovery.
